summary: API route for one-shot lean roles with CLI fallback, report and parity tools; design block added for the recurrence gate

requirements.evidence: bin/lean/lean.mjs:2399 (enumerating_fix, duplicate_fix), bin/lean/lean.mjs:2685 (contract_correction); each falls back to the CLI round on any failure
bin/lean/api-runner.mjs:40-42 cache_control on system and shared prefix (rubric, contract, diff); bin/lean/prompts.mjs stable prefix

self_review.evidence: git diff origin/staging...HEAD touches deliverables and tests only

amendments.text: contract correction, enumerating and duplicate-check fixes run as API-routed roles (lean.api_roles: contract_correction, enumerating_fix, duplicate_fix), toolless, with exact search/replace edits applied by the engine and the CLI round as fallback
amendments.why: the earlier commits 0fe4d8f0 and 8f66ff21 delivered these roles, so the deferral in the frozen contract no longer applies

amendments.text: the API roles carry a small shared cacheable prefix (rubric, contract, diff) with cache_control instead of full CLI sessions; rollout stays opt-in via lean.api_roles
amendments.why: the cacheable prefix is implemented in api-runner.mjs and prompts.mjs; only the rollout cohort is an operator decision

outcome.metric: fresh CLI sessions and cost per merged issue (bin/lean/api-report.mjs, before/after by cutoff)
outcome.target: 35-45% lower cost per merged issue for roles in lean.api_roles with blocking-finding parity (api-parity.mjs)
